Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the initial task decomposition by incorrectly identifying the husband of Caterina Visconti as Gian Galeazzo Visconti. Caterina Visconti was actually married to Sigismondo Malatesta (her first husband) and later to Francesco Sforza (her second husband). Gian Galeazzo Visconti was her uncle, not her husband. Because the Planner started the search with the wrong individual, the subsequent search for "Gian Galeazzo Visconti birthplace" (which correctly returned Milan) was irrelevant to the actual question, leading to a wrong final answer (Milan) instead of the correct one (Pavia, the birthplace of Francesco Sforza).
